money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; EMD exemption not allowed. Original EMD must reach the office within 7 days of technical bid opening. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (Building civil work) in Central Govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State Govt

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost; value updated at 7% p.a. simple; certificates from client organization
Similar works: Repairs & Maintenance or Construction work of any type of Building (RCC or Masonry)
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit (2025) of not being blacklisted or debarred by Central/State government organizations
Undertaking that price bid is unconditional
Tender acceptance letter; all other documents as per Section VI
notes: Only the NIT pages (numbered 3-6) are included; no BOQ or Section VI. NIT itself carries no date; publication taken as start of bid download period 23/01/2025 11:00. Bid submission ends 10/02/2025 15:00; technical bid opening 11/02/2025 16:00. Bidders advised to visit site.
